mode.title: Scraping Mode
mode.description: Choose whether to scrape top newsletters by category or provide specific publication URLs.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Select one or more categories to scrape from the leaderboards.

maxPublicationsPerCategory.title: Max Newsletters per Category
maxPublicationsPerCategory.description: Maximum number of newsletters to extract per selected category (e.g., 25, 50, 100).

publicationUrls.title: Specific Publication URLs
publicationUrls.description: Substack publication URLs to scrape (used when Mode is set to 'Scrape Specific Newsletter URLs').

scrapeLatestPosts.title: Scrape Latest Articles
scrapeLatestPosts.description: Extract the latest 3-5 posts with titles, dates, like counts, and comment metrics for each newsletter.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. By default, standard Apify proxies or direct connections are used.
